title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 39,361 Official Dossiers Across 37 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 39,361 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 844 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 37 active jurisdictions: United States (15,273 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (2,677 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,377 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (4,283 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (6,961 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (180 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,269 dossiers | Catalog), International (982 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (164 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (189 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (66 dossiers | Catalog), France (403 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (71 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (76 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (337 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (43 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (25 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (85 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (88 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (32 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (34 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (47 dossiers | Catalog), China (31 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (150 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (39 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (38 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Iceland (14 dossiers | Catalog), Lithuania (0 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (26 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Ukraine (1 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
